title: Composition with an etale morphism is left adjoint to base change on small etale sites
statement:
Let $j:Y\to X$ be an etale morphism of schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism], and let $Y_{\Et}$, $X_{\Et}$ be the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Then:

1. For an object $(V,v:V\to Y)$ of $Y_{\Et}$ the composite $j\circ v:V\to X$ is etale, and $\iota_j(V,v)=(V,j\circ v)$, $\iota_j(a)=a$ on morphisms, is a functor $\iota_j:Y_{\Et}\to X_{\Et}$.
2. For an object $(W,w:W\to X)$ of $X_{\Et}$ choose a fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] $W\times_XY$ (of $w$ and $j$) with projections $p_W:W\times_XY\to W$ and $q_W:W\times_XY\to Y$. Then $q_W$ is etale, and $b_j(W)=(W\times_XY,q_W)$, $b_j(g)=g\times\mathrm{id}_Y$ on morphisms, is a functor $b_j:X_{\Et}\to Y_{\Et}$.
3. $\iota_j$ is left adjoint to $b_j$: for $V\in Y_{\Et}$ and $W\in X_{\Et}$ the map $\operatorname{Hom}_{Y_{\Et}}(V,b_jW)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{X_{\Et}}(\iota_jV,W)$, $\varphi\mapsto p_W\circ\varphi$, is bijective and natural in $V$ and $W$. The counit $\varepsilon_W:\iota_jb_jW\to W$ is the projection $p_W:(W\times_XY,\,j\circ q_W)\to(W,w)$, and the unit $V\to b_j\iota_jV$ is $(\mathrm{id}_V,v):V\to V\times_XY$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 021H (lemma-morphism-big-etale), proof: "the functor $v$ is a right adjoint because given $U/T$ and $V/S$ we have $\Mor_S(u(U), V) = \Mor_T(U, V \times_S T)$" (stated there for big etale sites; the same computation on the small sites, with Lemma Tag 021D for fibre products and Lemma Tag 0217 for base change of etale coverings)
